session_summary: As a first-time player, I selected the 'Moss Trail' starting route and successfully completed all 12 steps, engaging with three enemy encounters (Goblin, Slime, and Kobold) and ending with 149 coins and 100 HP.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows the session began directly with walking actions on Moss Trail without prior tutorial prompts, matching development backlog item P2.
observations.recommendation: Implement welcome tooltips at step 0 to guide new players through initial movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: The walk trace consistently progressed forward step-by-step to complete the Moss Trail and award 25 coins cleanly.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the clear step progression feedback for route completions.

feature_requests.title: Initial Onboarding Tooltip Integration
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand controls and rules immediately upon starting their first route.
feature_requests.rationale: Without onboarding prompts, new players must guess how movement and combat interactions work.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display a brief introductory text box explaining walk and combat actions at the start of Moss Trail.

keep: Smooth step-by-step progression through Moss Trail
Clear reward messaging upon route completion (+25 coins)
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
